text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Students from the school Air Groove's
mother
runs are attending Tracen's open
house event
today, and I've been tasked
with helping out.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this place is amazing! It's so big!
The turf is
so green!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Please settle down, everyone! And
watch your
steps! We don't want any of
you taking a tumble!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer! Please keep an eye
on the
children so nothing goes awry
during the trial
lesson.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...And it's important to replenish your
body's
energy after a race by eating
carbohydrates.
Banana and rice balls are
good options for—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Brrriiing!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah!
What's happening?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: A-an alarm?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hello, security? I need you to confirm
the
situation as soon as—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Hey, what was that big sound?! I know! It was a huge fire blowing up and going bwoom!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You mean there's a fire?! This is bad! We need to get away! Run, everyone! Ugh, I'm scared... Sob, sob...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, eyes on me! ☆ It's
moments like
these when you need to
keep calm! Remain united
in spirit, and
don't stray from the group.
choice_data_list: みんな、ひとまず静かに――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
First, breathe deeply and release the
tension from
your shoulders! Copy me
now. Let's sway baaack
and fooorth.
Baaack and fooorth.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: B-baaack... and fooorth...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can hear you. I see... So it was the
alarm
from the kitchen? We'll start
evacuating from this
area just to be safe,
then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Okay, everyone! We're going outside
now!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This way! We're following a route that
takes us as
far from the kitchen as
possible!
choice_data_list: 廊下側の子から順番にいこう

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Walk briskly, but no running! Mind the
distance
between yourself and those
around you! One,
two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove takes the lead as soon as we
start to
evacuate. Conversely, her
mother watches over
the children from
the rear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh... It's no good. This door is locked.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
What?! Does that mean we can't get
out?
Nooo! Let me out!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? But isn't this actually kind of
fun? ♪
It's like we're explorers in a
maze, searching for
the exit!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
We're explorers? Ooh, okay! Let's look
for the
exit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Air Groove and her mother
working in
perfect harmony, we
successfully evacuate the
building
without incident.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It appears that all the children are safely
on their
way home. ...I'm truly glad that
it was only an
alarm malfunction in the
end, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Who could have imagined that their trial
lesson
would become an evacuation
drill?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
All's well that ends well! We were able
to restart
the lesson once things calmed
down, so I'm sure
the kids had a good
time in the end!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It was all thanks to your assistance,
Mother.
And... you did well too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fact of the matter is, if those two
weren't
there, panic and chaos would've
ensued, and the
evacuation wouldn't
have been as smooth.
choice_data_list: いや、2人のコンビネーションのおかげだ
いや、2人のコンビネーションのおかげだよ

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hehe. We were in perfect sync, weren't we? We sure make a dynamic duo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
When we support one another, we help

accentuate the other's strong points! The
two of
us can achieve anything as long
as we work
together.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I mean, we're the mother-daughter
dream team!
Right, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...M-Mother! I'm honored to hear you say
so!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Come now, you're still talking like that?!
Well,
whatever. That's just who you are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I got to witness the
unconventional yet
wonderful
relationship between Air Groove and
her
mother.
